import unittest
from unittest.mock import Mock
from datetime import datetime, timedelta

class TestVirtualClinic(unittest.TestCase):

    def test_speciality_wise_consultations(self):
        # Mock database query to return consultations data
        consultations_data = {
            "Cardiology": {"January": 10, "Q1": 20, "2022": 30},
            "Dermatology": {"January": 15, "Q1": 25, "2022": 35}
        }
        mock_db = Mock()
        mock_db.query.return_value = consultations_data

        # Call the function to get speciality wise consultations
        speciality_wise_consultations = get_speciality_wise_consultations(mock_db)

        # Assert the result
        self.assertEqual(speciality_wise_consultations, consultations_data)
